title: GOLDEN 40S - The Red Route
creativeIntent: Decisive 2D film test. Tell one simple story with exact CURRENT handles already proven in the working Simple V1 authoring path: establish geography, introduce one threat, show a clear attacker-target-impact chain, give one human reaction beat, complete a ground-to-ship handoff, launch, and end on a clean space coda. No fake 3D.

testPlan.purpose: Separate Preview quality from authoring/story quality.
coreChecks: 2D screen geography is readable without explanatory prose
VFX does not erase the subject
two named dialogue identities remain distinct
scale changes from surface action to space coda
ending resolves the story rather than merely stopping
testPlan.truthRule: Browser motion or VFX timing beyond serialized fields is Preview inference. Unity remains authoritative for runtime materialization.

beats.storyClaim: The last evacuation bus crosses the red route with a ground escort.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: Escort and bus enter in the same left-to-right screen direction.

camera.subject: bus
camera.purpose: Establish one simple screen geography before danger begins.

beats.evidence: The mecha is foreground-left, the bus is mid-right, and both enter from the left.

beats.storyClaim: A ground bomb drops directly over the route while the bus remains visible below.

actions.subject: ground_bomb
actions.result: The bomb enters from the top and establishes an unmistakable vertical threat over the bus.

camera.subject: ground_bomb
camera.purpose: Keep bomb and bus in one frame so the threat relationship is immediately readable.

beats.evidence: The bomb is visibly above the bus in the same frame.

beats.storyClaim: The escort fires once and intercepts the falling threat before it reaches the bus.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: One clean defensive shot: attacker, target, impact, then target disappears.

actions.subject: ground_bomb
actions.result: The bomb deactivates after the visible impact.

camera.subject: mecha
camera.purpose: Do not decorate the action. Make cause and effect readable.

beats.evidence: Mecha, bomb and bus are simultaneously readable; an impact occurs on the bomb and the bomb disappears.

beats.storyClaim: A blast erupts behind the convoy, but the bus survives and the route remains open.

actions.subject: mecha
actions.result: A large explosion occupies the rear of the route while the bus remains clearly visible ahead of it.

camera.subject: bus
camera.purpose: Keep the surviving bus as the visual priority while the explosion supplies urgency behind it.

beats.evidence: The bus remains visible and intact while a large explosion appears behind the convoy.

beats.storyClaim: Two pilots make the decision that turns the chase into an evacuation handoff.

dialogue.speaker: green_pilot
dialogue.text: The road is open. Send the last ship.

camera.subject: green_pilot
camera.purpose: A short cut-based dialogue beat tests identity and pacing without forbidden locked-dialogue camera motion.

beats.evidence: Two distinct named speakers trade two short lines and remain distinct identities.

beats.storyClaim: The last bus reaches the evacuation craft and the ground story acquires a visible destination.

actions.subject: bus
actions.result: The bus and evacuation craft converge in a single readable 2D handoff composition.

camera.subject: evac_ship
camera.purpose: Make the destination explicit instead of cutting away before the handoff reads.

beats.evidence: Bus and evacuation craft are simultaneously visible and spatially close in the same Mars frame.

beats.storyClaim: The evacuation craft lifts from the surface while the ground escort is left behind.

actions.subject: evac_ship
actions.result: The craft rises from the lower frame; the stationary escort provides scale and closure for the ground action.

camera.subject: evac_ship
camera.purpose: Shift the film from ground-scale urgency to a larger departure image using 2D scale and framing only.

beats.evidence: The ship enters upward from the bottom while a much smaller ground escort remains below.

beats.storyClaim: The evacuation craft joins its escort in open space and the film resolves into calm forward motion.

actions.subject: command_ship
actions.result: The two friendly ships settle into the same direction and scale relationship.

camera.subject: evac_ship
camera.purpose: End on a large quiet environment with two small surviving ships instead of another action beat.

beats.evidence: Only the two friendly ships remain as small readable shapes against open space.
